Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2410)

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.

Observed:
- C was selected most often and rejected for: south refunds, north claims, east shipments, and east small claim. C accepted only for REQ-2408: small shipment, north region, from Regional Ops, “second attempt.”
- B accepted once: REQ-2409, large refund, east region, from Finance Desk, “asking twice.”
- B was rejected for REQ-2407: large claim, south region, Field Sales.
- A has not been tried; likely default when B/C fail.

Tentative rules:
- Claims: try A first. B/C have failed or been flagged invalid for north/south/east claims.
- Large refunds from east: B priority desk.
- Small shipments from north via Regional Ops: C regional office.
- Other refunds/shipments: start with A; do not default to C.

Caveats:
- Outcome text is inconsistent with selected option in places: step 6 selected B but says “C is not valid”; step 9 selected C but says “B is not valid.” Trust the success/reject flag over the message.
- Region, request type, size, sender role, and urgency phrases appear relevant, but no stable rule yet beyond the two accepted cases.
- Before escalating, check: region, claim/refund/shipment, small/large, sender desk/role, and repeat-contact wording.
- If A is rejected, test B for large refunds and C only for north small shipments.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2420)

Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.

Accepted:
- A: REQ-2414 large invoice, east, Field Sales, “asking twice.” REQ-2416 large shipment, south, Finance, “No rush.”
- B: REQ-2409 large refund, east, Finance, “asking twice.”
- C: REQ-2408 small shipment, north, Regional Ops, “second attempt.”

A rejected (new):
- large invoice north Field Sales “No rush”
- large shipment north Finance “Second attempt”
- large claim east Finance/Field Sales “regional office”
- small shipment east Client Services “same as last month”
- small claim south/north Regional Ops
- small shipment south Regional Ops “second attempt”

So A is not a safe default for claims, small shipments, or north large shipments/invoices. A still worked for one large invoice east Field Sales with repeat/urgent wording and one large shipment south Finance no-rush.

Claims: do not start with A. B known invalid for large claim south Field Sales; C invalid for north claims and east small claim. No stable claim rule yet; test B/C by region/sender.

Shipments: C likely for small shipments from Regional Ops (north accepted; south A rejected). A can work for large shipment south Finance no rush. B unknown for shipments.

Invoices: A for east large Field Sales with “asking twice”; not for north large Field Sales no rush. If A rejected, try B for priority/urgent, C for regional/Regional Ops.

Caveats: REQ-2411 selected A but rejection says “C is not valid”; trust reject/success flag. Check region, type (claim/refund/shipment/invoice), size, sender role, repeat/urgency wording before escalating. If A rejected: try C for Regional Ops small shipments; B for urgent/large east refunds; claims remain uncertain.

Working notes — desk assignment (REQ-2401–2430)

Options: A standard, B priority, C regional.

Accepted:
A: large invoice east Field Sales “asking twice” (2414); large shipment south Finance no rush (2416).
B: large refund east Finance “asking twice” (2409); large refund north Field Sales no rush/confirm (2424).
C: small shipment north Regional Ops “second attempt” (2408); large invoice north Field Sales no rush/confirm (2430).

New rejections:
A rejected for: small invoice east Regional Ops “asking twice” (2427); plus prior small shipments/claims, north large invoice no rush, north large shipment Finance repeat.
B rejected for: small refund east Regional Ops scanned/not typed (2421); large shipment north Finance before EOD (2425). Known invalid for large claim south Field Sales.
C rejected for: large claim south Field Sales (2422); small shipment east Regional Ops “second attempt” (2428). Known invalid for north claims/east small claim.

Rules:
Invoices: A works only for large east Field Sales with urgent/repeat. A fails small east and north large no-rush. C works north large Field Sales no-rush. If A rejected, try B urgent/priority, C regional/Regional Ops.
Shipments: A works large south Finance no-rush. C works small north Regional Ops repeat, but not east small Regional Ops. B invalid large north Finance; B unknown otherwise.
Refunds: B works large refunds (east Finance urgent; north Field Sales no-rush). B invalid for small east Regional Ops.
Claims: no stable rule. Do not start A. B invalid south large; C invalid south large Field Sales and north. Test by region/sender, not size alone.

Caveats: trust success/reject flag; rejection option letter may be misleading. Check region, type, size, sender, repeat/urgency before escalating.

B: not reliable small east (2431, 2440); invalid large north Finance.

No stable rule. B accepted large north Finance scanned (2432); B invalid large south and large east Field Sales regional-office (2450). A invalid large south Field Sales scanned (2445). C invalid south small/large Field Sales and north. Test region/sender, not size.
